subject: HW sprint queue handover & vendor/cloud fallback commitments
messages:
From: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
To: Timothy Lewis <timothy.lewis@calico-oem.com>, Anjali Rao <anjali.rao@stratuscloud.com>, procure@acmeai.com
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 4 Jun 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: HW sprint queue handover & vendor/cloud fallback commitments

Team & partners —

TL;DR: AcmeAI wants a locked sprint window for dedicated capacity in Sept-Oct tied to their production launch. We need firm OEM shipable tranche dates and a cloud hold for initial staging. Please review the asks below and confirm by EOW so we can lock the MAP.

Background:
- AcmeAI (deal ACME-DED-2028-07) has signaled a go-live in early Q4 and wants 1.2k accelerator cards reserved in our dedicated pool.
- They are prepared to accept split shipments if that materially shortens lead time, and to put a deposit for a priority lane.

Asks (please action):
1) Timothy / Calico: Can you confirm the earliest ship dates for a 30/40/30 tranche split and whether you can commit a priority lane for the first tranche? Also confirm incoterms, customs blockers, and whether partial manifests ship with serial numbers for early burn-in. See attached: calico_quote_v3.pdf.
2) Anjali / Stratus: Can Stratus hold (soft-reserve) staging capacity in us-west-2 for a 4-week window starting 2028-08-20 while we complete customs and staging? If not, advise the closest region with hold capability and any burst credit terms. Attached: stratus_capacity_sheet.xlsx.
3) Internal ops/procurement: If both vendor and cloud can hold the slots above, we need procurement to approve a 30% deposit and to route the DocuSign MAP. Ben, can you confirm finance cadence? Karthik, once vendor dates land, please map to our deploy lanes and provide an ETA/slot plan.

Attachments: calico_quote_v3.pdf (quote, updated pricing), stratus_capacity_sheet.xlsx (capacity hold SLAs).

Next steps: Please reply with straight answers to 1–3 by Fri 2028-06-08 17:00 PT. If any party cannot meet those dates, propose the fastest fallback (partial ship, alternate cloud region, expedited customs).

Thanks,
David
David Kim
Head of Fleet Planning, Redwood Inference
---
From: Timothy Lewis <timothy.lewis@calico-oem.com>
To: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>, Anjali Rao <anjali.rao@stratuscloud.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 4 Jun 2028 13:41:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: HW sprint queue handover & vendor/cloud fallback commitments

David —

Appreciate the clear asks. Short answers up front: we can support a 3-tranche split (30/40/30) with partial shipping, and we can prioritize the first tranche with a committed production slot — provided the deposit and payment milestones align with our updated terms. Full details below.

Details / constraints:
- Earliest first-tranche ship: 2028-08-28 (ETD from factory) if deposit received and PO lock by 2028-06-16.
- Second tranche estimated ship window: 2028-09-18 to 2028-09-30.
- Final tranche: 2028-10-20 to 2028-11-05.
- Priority lane: available for first tranche (adds 6% to unit price). Works on a first-pay/first-ship basis.
- Serialized manifests: yes — we can provide serial numbers and partial manifests for early firmware burn-in and traceability.
- Customs: shipments originate from SEA; target port is Oakland. Current port slot risk is moderate (2–3 week variance). We recommend built-in 14-day slack on target arrival.

I attached the updated quote (calico_quote_v3.pdf) which reflects the priority-lane uplift and revised lead times. On terms: 30% deposit, 50% on first tranche shipment, balance on final tranche acceptance. We can accelerate the PO->slot pipeline if Redwood provides a one-page supplier guarantee and agrees to a 30% non-refundable deposit.

If AcmeAI needs earlier staging, we can explore an air-lift for a small pilot (50 cards) — cost will be material but could buy two weeks. Let me know if you want pricing for that option.

Thanks,
Timothy Lewis
Director, OEM Partnerships
Calico Hardware Solutions
Attachments: calico_quote_v3.pdf
---
From: Anjali Rao <anjali.rao@stratuscloud.com>
To: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>, Timothy Lewis <timothy.lewis@calico-oem.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 5 Jun 2028 08:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: HW sprint queue handover & vendor/cloud fallback commitments

David / team —

We can accommodate a soft hold for a 4-week staging window in us-west-2 starting 2028-08-20, subject to a signed mutual action plan and a one-time staging reservation fee. The hold will reserve up to 1.5k GPU instances (enough for the first two tranches) with a guaranteed baseline throughput for onboarding runs.

Notes on holds and fallback:
- Hold expiry: we can hold slots until 2028-07-20 without a signed MAP; after that, we require the MAP signature and staging fee to lock the slots.
- Burst credits: we can provision an initial burst pool for 7 days free to validate integration; extended burst will be billed per the sheet.
- Alternate region: if us-west-2 becomes constrained, us-west-1 and us-east-1 are options; cross-region replication for staging state will add 12–18 hours to the onboarding window.

I've uploaded the Stratus capacity sheet (stratus_capacity_sheet.xlsx) with the hold terms and the staging SLA. We can also provide a temporary private peering agreement for faster dataset sync — that will require a short engineering kickoff.

Action items from Stratus:
1) Hold provisional slots until 2028-07-20.
2) Provide staging SLA and burst-credit details (see attachment).

If you want me to escalate to account execs for a longer unconditional hold, say so and I will route it.

Best,
Anjali Rao
Enterprise Cloud Partnerships, StratusCloud
Attachments: stratus_capacity_sheet.xlsx

From: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>

Date: Tue, 5 Jun 2028 15:28:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: HW sprint queue handover & vendor/cloud fallback commitments

Folks —

Condensed plan and immediate asks after vendor/cloud responses:

1) Accept Calico's 3-tranche plan and priority lane for tranche 1. Timelines: 1st ETD 2028-08-28, 2nd window late Sept, final tranche late Oct. Ben: get finance to OK 30% deposit and route DocuSign. I attached the MAP draft (mutual_action_plan_ACME.docx) — please prep for e-sign by 2028-06-15.

2) Take Stratus soft-hold on us-west-2 through 2028-07-20. Karthik: plan the staging runway to start 2028-08-20 and map our deploy lanes to the manifests Calico will provide. Confirm whether we need private peering for faster sync; if yes, start the ticket.

3) Contingency: Air-lift 50 cards as pilot only if customs/port risk grows > 3 weeks. Ben/Vanessa: please prepare quick cost approval path (finance sign-off) and list of required docs for customs.

4) DocuSign + deposit timeline: target PO + signed MAP by 2028-06-16 to hit the first-tranche ship date.

I'll own communications with Calico/Stratus through closing. Vanessa, please update the customer-facing MAP and schedule a short alignment with Acme procurement (procure@acmeai.com) tomorrow to confirm their payment cadence.

Thanks — straightforward asks, quick turn.

-David
David Kim
Head of Fleet Planning, Redwood Inference
Attachments: mutual_action_plan_ACME.docx
